supersedes_nothing: The frozen preregistration and freeze manifest are unchanged. This document adds analysis rules; it does not alter any configuration, checkpoint, donor assignment or comparison order.

terminology.mapping: The physical column named `fallback` in the frozen F5 reference Parquet files, and the `donor_fallback_levels` / `donor_pool_coarsened_users` keys in the frozen build audits, all denote DONOR BUCKET RELAXATION LEVEL and nothing else. The frozen files keep their original column name because they are hashed in the build manifest; every new artifact, table and document uses `bucket_relaxation`.
explicitly_not: not a retained-length mismatch: matched and donor retained length are equal on every row, verified at build time
not an invalid or missing donor: every row has a different-user donor
not a future event or an ownership error

levels.0: donor shares the target's exact retained length, activity bucket and recency bucket
levels.1: exact retained length and activity bucket; recency bucket relaxed
levels.2: exact retained length only; activity and recency buckets relaxed
levels.3: donor retained length at least the target's, contributing its own most recent n events; NEVER USED, zero rows on every date

main_analysis.sample: all formal test impressions, 3,308,665 rows, no exclusion
main_analysis.rule: The main analysis uses the complete formal sample. Bucket relaxation does not exclude any row from it.

donor_sensitivity_analysis.purpose: Determine whether donor bucket relaxation affects the matched-minus-mismatched conclusion. Diagnostic only.
donor_sensitivity_analysis.procedure: Recompute the matched-minus-mismatched difference after excluding every target row whose bucket_relaxation level is greater than zero, for both mean and attention pooling, on AUC, LogLoss, PR-AUC and GAUC.
donor_sensitivity_analysis.per_row_markers: results/f5_sequence_test_v1/bucket_relaxation_markers.parquet, one row per test impression with impression_id and bucket_relaxation level, derived from the frozen reference file without modifying it
donor_sensitivity_analysis.status: This sensitivity analysis DOES NOT replace the main analysis and does not redefine any frozen comparison. If it disagrees with the main analysis, both are reported and the disagreement is stated.
donor_sensitivity_analysis.no_reselection: No model, donor, length, learning rate or primary-model choice may change because of this analysis.

cold_start_quadrant.source: src/10_evaluate_predictions.py add_cold_start_flags on the base test table
cold_start_quadrant.definition: known means present in the train-only raw ID vocabulary

f5_history_length.source: raw_length in the frozen F5 test references

behavior_type_composition.source: type tokens of the retained matched window in the F5 event store
behavior_type_composition.metric: count of non-pv events (cart, fav, buy) inside the retained window

recency.source: recency_bucket in the frozen F5 test history file
recency.note: empty-history rows have no recency bucket and are reported as a separate cell

user_activity.note: same bin edges the existing D2 activity analysis used, so the two are comparable

unknown_category_rate.source: category tokens of the retained matched window
unknown_category_rate.metric: share of retained tokens whose category index is UNKNOWN
unknown_category_rate.note: empty-history rows are reported as a separate cell

f4_by_f5_emptiness_cross.source: length in the frozen F4 and F5 test references
f4_by_f5_emptiness_cross.expected_asymmetry: F4 leaves 999,659 test rows empty and F5 leaves 14,397, so the F4-empty / F5-nonempty cell is expected to dominate. That is a property of the two sources, not a result.

prefixed_group_partitions.rule: No group may be added, split or re-binned after any test metric is observed. Any post-hoc partition must be labelled post-hoc and reported separately from these.

uncertainty_reporting.user_sampling: paired user-cluster bootstrap over test users, conditional on the frozen checkpoints and the single test day
uncertainty_reporting.training_randomness: sample mean and standard deviation over the three residual seeds, reported separately and never merged with the bootstrap interval
uncertainty_reporting.zero_control: one deterministic predictor on the shared frozen backbone. Its three references are the same predictor evaluated three times, not three independently fitted models, and its standard deviation of zero is structural.
uncertainty_reporting.shared_backbone: all five conditions share one frozen DeepFM checkpoint, so no contrast among them is a full-model comparison

calibration.method: the calibration method already selected and frozen on validation is applied to test
calibration.rule: no calibration method may be chosen or refitted using any test metric
calibration.reporting: raw and calibrated metrics are both reported

forbidden_after_test: adding a favourable group and presenting it as preregistered

questions_the_final_report_must_answer: Does F5 improve stably over the zero pipeline null?
Is F5 matched stably better than F5 mismatched?
Does F5 clearly exceed the sparse clicked-ad sequence F4?
Is attention stably better than mean pooling?
Does donor bucket relaxation affect the matched-minus-mismatched conclusion?
Does F5 narrow the global AUC gap between LR and the sequence models?
Is the F5 gain worth its model size, latency, throughput and memory cost?
